test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The pie chart given below shows the expenditure incurred by a person on 7 articles. The total expenditure of all these 7 articles is 1800. Expenditure incurred on a particular article is shown in terms of degree with respect to the total expenditure incurred in all these 7 articles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9d16385038a86d0a7a62a6d5cb8f8e91d13cefa1fa03b83a51e426d8452b539.png] 

Expenditure incurred on article L is what percent of expenditure incurred on article P?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Expenditure incurred on article L is 15° 

The expenditure incurred on article P is 10°

Required percentage is 15 /10 × 100 = 150 %

**∴ The correct option is 4**
